newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CS Holding shares rise, speculation swirls.
newsitem.headline: CS Holding shares rise, speculation swirls.

text.p: CS Holding registered shares were up three Swiss francs to 135.50 in heavy trading but off a high of 136. Dealers cited foreign buying, unsubstantiated rumours of CS deals with other banks, and three new series of call options.

"It is clear that there is more than just hot air behind CS Holding's rise," one dealer said. Analysts played down one rumour that ABN Amro could acquire investment bank CS First Boston from CS. "CS would hardly sell one of the legs it stands on," one said. Others cited rumours of a cross-holding between CS Holding and Commerzbank or technical factors. CS Holding does not comment on market rumours.
